metrics.label: Upset wins
metrics.desc: Wins when the pre-match Elo probability was below 40 %.

metrics.label: Upset losses
metrics.desc: Losses when the pre-match Elo probability was above 60 %.

metrics.label: Wins over expected
metrics.desc: Wins minus the sum of pre-match Elo win probabilities (walk-forward: each probability uses only results before the match). Positive = winning more than the ratings expected.

metrics.label: Wins over expected per match
metrics.desc: Wins over expected per match.

metrics.label: Average opponent Elo
metrics.desc: Mean overall Elo of the opponents before each match.

metrics.label: Win % on hard
metrics.desc: Win % on hard courts (carpet folds into hard).

metrics.desc: Win % on clay.

metrics.label: Win % on grass
metrics.desc: Win % on grass.

metrics.label: Win % indoors
metrics.desc: Win % indoors.

metrics.label: Hold %
metrics.desc: Hold % (chain scale): P(holding serve). Inferred from game and set scores by the serve/return model (fitted through the season's end), against the average tour-level opponent.

metrics.label: Serve rating
metrics.desc: Serve strength s (logit scale): how much more than the tour baseline the player holds. Inferred from game and set scores by the serve/return model (fitted through the season's end), against the average tour-level opponent.

metrics.label: Serve points won % (model)
metrics.desc: Serve points won % implied by the hold rate (inverse of the game formula, with the tour's point-link offset). Inferred from game and set scores by the serve/return model (fitted through the season's end), against the average tour-level opponent.

metrics.label: Serve rating s.e.
metrics.desc: Standard error of the serve rating (Laplace approximation): lower = more evidence.

metrics.label: Hold % on hard
metrics.desc: Hold % on hard courts. Inferred from game and set scores by the serve/return model (fitted through the season's end), against the average tour-level opponent.

metrics.label: Hold % on clay
metrics.desc: Hold % on clay. Inferred from game and set scores by the serve/return model (fitted through the season's end), against the average tour-level opponent.

metrics.label: Hold % on grass
metrics.desc: Hold % on grass. Inferred from game and set scores by the serve/return model (fitted through the season's end), against the average tour-level opponent.

metrics.label: Hold % v strong returners
metrics.desc: Calibrated hold % against the 20 best returners of the season (hard court, average level).

metrics.label: Break %
metrics.desc: Break %: P(breaking serve). Inferred from game and set scores by the serve/return model (fitted through the season's end), against the average tour-level opponent.

metrics.label: Return rating
metrics.desc: Return strength r (logit scale). Inferred from game and set scores by the serve/return model (fitted through the season's end), against the average tour-level opponent.

metrics.label: Return points won % (model)
metrics.desc: Return points won % implied by the break rate. Inferred from game and set scores by the serve/return model (fitted through the season's end), against the average tour-level opponent.

metrics.label: Return rating s.e.
metrics.desc: Standard error of the return rating.

metrics.label: Break % on hard
metrics.desc: Break % on hard courts. Inferred from game and set scores by the serve/return model (fitted through the season's end), against the average tour-level opponent.

metrics.label: Break % on clay
metrics.desc: Break % on clay. Inferred from game and set scores by the serve/return model (fitted through the season's end), against the average tour-level opponent.

metrics.label: Break % on grass
metrics.desc: Break % on grass. Inferred from game and set scores by the serve/return model (fitted through the season's end), against the average tour-level opponent.

metrics.label: Break % v strong servers
metrics.desc: Calibrated break % against the 20 best servers of the season (hard court, average level).

metrics.label: Serve + return rating
metrics.desc: Serve rating + return rating: overall strength on the serve/return scale.

metrics.label: Hold % + break %
metrics.desc: Hold % + break %: above 100 % wins more service and return games combined than an average player.

metrics.label: Matches with stats
metrics.desc: Matches with official WTA statistics. From the official WTA match statistics (women's matches with stats only).

metrics.label: Ace %
metrics.desc: Aces / serve points. From the official WTA match statistics (women's matches with stats only).

metrics.label: Double-fault %
metrics.desc: Double faults / serve points. From the official WTA match statistics (women's matches with stats only).

metrics.label: 1st serve in %
metrics.desc: First serves in / serve points. From the official WTA match statistics (women's matches with stats only).

metrics.label: 1st serve points won %
metrics.desc: Points won on the first serve / first serves in. From the official WTA match statistics (women's matches with stats only).

metrics.label: 2nd serve points won %
metrics.desc: Points won on the second serve / second serves. From the official WTA match statistics (women's matches with stats only).

metrics.label: Serve points won %
metrics.desc: Serve points won / serve points. From the official WTA match statistics (women's matches with stats only).

metrics.label: Hold % (actual)
metrics.desc: Service games held / service games (breaks = break points faced - saved). From the official WTA match statistics (women's matches with stats only).

metrics.label: Break points saved %
metrics.desc: Break points saved / faced. From the official WTA match statistics (women's matches with stats only).

metrics.label: Break points faced per service game
metrics.desc: Break points faced per service game. From the official WTA match statistics (women's matches with stats only).

metrics.label: Aces per match
metrics.desc: Aces per match. From the official WTA match statistics (women's matches with stats only).

metrics.label: Double faults per match
metrics.desc: Double faults per match. From the official WTA match statistics (women's matches with stats only).

metrics.label: Serve points won v expected
metrics.desc: Serve points won % minus expected. From the official WTA match statistics (women's matches with stats only). Expected = the model's calibrated value against the actual opponents, weighted by the points or games played.

metrics.label: Hold % v expected
metrics.desc: Hold % minus expected. From the official WTA match statistics (women's matches with stats only). Expected = the model's calibrated value against the actual opponents, weighted by the points or games played.

metrics.label: Return points won %
metrics.desc: Return points won / opponents' serve points. From the official WTA match statistics (women's matches with stats only).

metrics.label: Break % (actual)
metrics.desc: Breaks / opponents' service games. From the official WTA match statistics (women's matches with stats only).

metrics.label: Break points converted %
metrics.desc: Break points converted / break points. From the official WTA match statistics (women's matches with stats only).

metrics.label: Break points per return game
metrics.desc: Break points earned per return game. From the official WTA match statistics (women's matches with stats only).

metrics.label: Total points won %
metrics.desc: Total points won %. From the official WTA match statistics (women's matches with stats only).

metrics.label: Dominance ratio
metrics.desc: Return points won % / serve points lost %: above 1 wins return points at a higher rate than losing serve points. From the official WTA match statistics (women's matches with stats only).

metrics.label: Return points won v expected
metrics.desc: Return points won % minus expected. From the official WTA match statistics (women's matches with stats only). Expected = the model's calibrated value against the actual opponents, weighted by the points or games played.

metrics.label: Break % v expected
metrics.desc: Break % minus expected. From the official WTA match statistics (women's matches with stats only). Expected = the model's calibrated value against the actual opponents, weighted by the points or games played.

metrics.label: Tiebreaks won

metrics.label: Tiebreaks lost
metrics.desc: Tiebreaks lost.

metrics.label: Tiebreak win %
metrics.desc: Tiebreaks won / played.

metrics.label: Tiebreak win % expected
metrics.desc: Mean P(win the tiebreak) from the exact chain with the match's serve-point probabilities (first server averaged; a deciding-set match tiebreak to 10 where the rules say so).

metrics.label: Tiebreaks won over expected
metrics.desc: Tiebreaks won minus the sum of their chain probabilities: clutch in tiebreaks.
